name: effective_tax_rate
label: Effective Tax Rate (Normalized Structural)
notes: EST judgment - normalized structural rate, NOT an observed effective rate. FY2025's effective rate of −126.997% (tax −231,655 on pretax 182,410) is a one-time valuation-allowance release and is prohibited as an anchor. FY2021 (−0.2952%) and FY2022 (−1.5997%) are not meaningful because both years had pretax losses. FY2023 9.6192% and FY2024 13.4225% are the only two positive-rate years in the corpus; the default takes FY2024, the most recent undistorted fiscal year (tax 13,732 / pretax 102,306 = 13.4225%). The rate sits below the 21% US federal statutory rate because of the valuation-allowance and foreign-tax-credit position - a modeling judgment the user can override.

name: beta
label: Levered Equity Beta
notes: MKT snapshot as of 2026-08-31: Bottom-up median unlevered beta = 1.47 across locked peer set (Spotify, Roblox, Netflix). Per-peer 60-month OLS regressions against S&P 500 (2021-09 to 2026-08) and Hamada unlevering on filed FY2025 D/E: (1) Spotify (SPOT): levered β = 1.5860, D/E = 1.64% (€1,956M total debt / $119,529M market cap), t = 21.0% -> unlevered β = 1.5657 (1.57); (2) Roblox (RBLX): levered β = 1.4742, D/E = 3.12% ($1,788M total debt / $57,398M market cap), t = 21.0% -> unlevered β = 1.4387 (1.44); (3) Netflix (NFLX): levered β = 1.5258, D/E = 4.29% ($16,976M total debt / $395,870M market cap), t = 13.7% -> unlevered β = 1.4713 (1.47). Peer statistics: median = 1.4713 (rounded to step 0.01 = 1.47), mean = 1.4919 (1.49), span = 0.1270 (0.13). Duolingo is debt-free (D = 0), so the median unlevered asset beta (1.47) applies directly without relevering (no Hamada adjustment applies). Cross-checks: Vasicek-shrunk own-regression (DUOL 60-observation window 2021-09 to 2026-08 OLS β = 0.890488, rounded to 0.89, t ≈ 1.72, R² = 4.83%, stderr = 0.519187 against S&P 500 Index) disclosed alongside; peer dispersion visible. Bear/bull deltas widen or narrow the systematic-risk input.

name: equity_risk_premium
label: Equity Risk Premium (US)
notes: MKT snapshot as of 2026-09-01 via Aswath Damodaran (NYU Stern) - trailing 3-month average of Damodaran's published monthly implied ERP for the United States (trailing 12-month with adjusted payout). Trailing 3-month monthly prints: 4.30% (2026-07-01), 4.28% (2026-08-01), and 4.14% (2026-09-01); unweighted average = (4.30% + 4.28% + 4.14%) / 3 = 4.2400%, rounded to driver step (0.0005) = 4.2500% (0.0425). Smoothing rule: value is the mechanical unweighted average of the trailing 3 monthly prints rounded to the driver step (0.0005). The annual January 5, 2026 country risk premium table (4.46%) is retired to eliminate structural staleness (Finding-C lineage remediation). Cross-check against Damodaran's historical implied-ERP series: 4.33% (2024) and 4.23% (2025). Series URL: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/pc/implprem/ERPbymonth.xlsx. Bear/bull deltas widen or narrow the premium.

name: terminal_growth_rate
label: Terminal Growth Rate (Perpetuity)
notes: EST judgment - long-run perpetuity growth for the Gordon terminal value. Set at 2.5%: strictly below the Base WACC (11.0375%, ~853.75bps of Gordon headroom) and below the long-run US nominal GDP growth ceiling of ~4.0% (~2.0% real + ~2.0% inflation), so the perpetuity never implies Duolingo outgrowing the economy that hosts it. Max bound is TERMINAL_GROWTH_BOUNDS.max (0.04) from constants.js. Not an MKT input - no market price reveals long-run growth - so it carries no as-of date. Contract-reading note: the P4.1 contract text says this driver is 'bounded below US nominal GDP growth'; that reads as an inversion of the standard Gordon ceiling (a perpetuity cannot grow faster than nominal GDP forever), so it is implemented here as an UPPER bound. OP ruling requested.
